style: Reconstruct the recognizable classic browser-game Mole Manor castle design language: warm cream limestone, red terracotta pointed roofs, golden cornices and scroll details, a large central clock and crown-shaped arched entrance. Preserve the playful landmark proportions while using detailed physically based stone, ceramic and metal surfaces. Standalone complete 3D architecture, all sides, no people, no terrain base. The courtyard layout is an interpretation, not a verified copy of an original game map.

assets.prompt: The classic Mole Manor royal castle silhouette: broad cream stone central palace, central square golden clock above a tall arched oak entrance, decorative golden crown relief with a red jewel over the doorway, paired slender cylindrical front towers with red terracotta cone roofs, golden roof edges, rear crenellated walls and several small turrets. Layered scalloped red roof tiles, carved gold window surrounds, fine limestone block joints. Width 32 meters, depth 16 meters, height 24 meters. Front faces positive Z.
